name: Hotel Kleon
beschreibung: Hotel Kleon is situated in Jerzens within Tyrol's scenic Pitztal Valley. Framed by the peaks of the Ötztal Alps, the property offers a relaxed mountain environment. In winter, a dedicated ski bus links directly to the family-friendly Hochzeiger ski resort and the Pitztal Glacier, while summer brings scenic alpine hiking paths. Facilities include a restorative wellness area with sauna and steam bath, alongside a restaurant serving hearty regional specialties.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Kleon in Jerzens in the Pitztal valley provides peaceful alpine lodging, a sauna and steam room, regional dining, and easy ski bus access to Hochzeiger.
